guides.name: Support DPS, group PvP — Game8

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A group-PvP support DPS Chanter built around Dark Crush. Impactful Crush, Tremor Crush and Wave Blow land the stuns and knockdowns that open Dark Crush, Marchutan's Wrath opens it again, and both mantras stay on. Gear leans on Attack, Critical Hit and Combat Speed, with PvP options on every manastone.

combat.openerNote: Skill sequence from the article; the R macro is Dark Crush > Tremor Crush > Gust Rampage.

rotation: Turn on Undefeated Mantra and Sprint Mantra before the fight.
Land a stun or knockdown (Impactful Crush, Tremor Crush, Wave Blow) to open Dark Crush.
Spend the window on the Dark Crush macro; Marchutan's Wrath opens it again.
Close distance with Rushing Smash or Fracturing Blow.
Between bursts, cast Recuperation to heal the party and clear Stun / Knockdown.

tips.title: Role
tips.text: Group PvP damage dealer that also controls: the same Dark Crush core as the PvE build, with more weight on stuns and knockdowns.

tips.title: Flexible stigma slot
tips.text: Fracturing Blow is the gap closer; swap it for Ensnaring Mark or Power of the Storm when the content calls for it.

tips.title: Macro delay
tips.text: Set the macro delay to roughly half your current ping.

tips.title: Recuperation as a cleanse
tips.text: In a party, use Recuperation often: it keeps allies alive and removes Stun and Knockdown from them.

tips.title: Deity stats
tips.text: The article's deity stat summary (Destruction, Destiny, Death, Time, Wisdom) and its ordered list (Destruction, Illusion, Death, Space, Time) disagree; the weights here follow the ordered list.

guides.name: Solo / arena PvP (notXeon) — aion2-guides.info

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A 1v1 / arena Chanter based on notXeon's arena duels. Every crowd-control skill takes its stun chance and duration picks. The plan: bait the enemy's Defiance with Impactful Crush, kite while it is on cooldown, then chain stun, knockdown and Dark Crush. Fracturing Blow turns into Sprint Mantra in the arena; the group stigmas are for team fights only.

combat.notes: notXeon plays duels by hand, without a macro. Keys are his arena hotbar; stacked cells use the first ready skill.

opener.note: From about 20 m: forces the enemy's Defiance
After their Defiance is used: stun again (or Impactful Crush)

combat.openerNote: Between the first stun and the second, kite until the enemy's Defiance is on cooldown (about a minute).

rotation: Open with Impactful Crush from range to force the enemy's Defiance.
Watch their buff bar: once Defiance is used it is down for about a minute, so kite until your control is ready.
Stun again (Impactful Crush or Marchutan's Wrath), knock the stunned target down with Wave Blow, then Dark Crush and Spinning Strike.
If they run, chase with Rushing Smash; Tremor Crush dodges and can stun after the dodge.

tips.title: Bait Defiance first
tips.text: Defiance is the main counter to a Chanter's control. Make the enemy spend it on your first stun, then commit your full chain while it is on cooldown.

tips.title: Stigma swaps
tips.text: Solo set: Undefeated Mantra, Marchutan's Wrath, Fracturing Blow, Guardian Blessing. In the arena (on the ground) Sprint Mantra replaces Fracturing Blow. Healing Touch, Impeding Authority and Power of the Storm are for group fights, not duels.

tips.title: Specializations
tips.text: Take stun and knockdown chance and duration wherever a skill offers them; the skills not listed for PvP keep their PvE picks.

tips.title: Defiance picks
tips.text: The page contradicts itself on Defiance: one place puts the 10% HP restore at 8 and the Crushing Strike chain at 12, another lists the chain at 8. Check the options in-game.

tips.title: Sprint Mantra
tips.text: The page also says notXeon runs Sprint Mantra for dungeons and farming and drops it in PvP, which conflicts with the arena swap. It matters most on the ground; in the Abyss most fighting is in the air.

guides.name: Group PvP defensive support — Fextralife

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A defensive group-PvP Chanter that protects allies instead of chasing kills. It stacks Max HP, PvP Damage Tolerance and Status Effect Resist, stuns divers with Impactful Crush, seals melee clumps with Spinning Strike, and saves Impeding Authority, Barrier Spell and Defiance for the moments that decide a fight.

rotation: Stay within range of your allies.
Stun divers with Impactful Crush, then Dark Crush to make them burn defensive cooldowns.
Drop Spinning Strike into packed melee to Seal and ignore Block / Evasion.
Cast Impeding Authority early, as the enemy engages.
Save Barrier Spell for an ally under lethal focus.
Keep Defiance for hard control, then reposition and cast Recuperation.

tips.title: Dark Crush window
tips.text: Dark Crush's cooldown removal only works within about 2 seconds after Spinning Strike or Impactful Crush.

tips.title: Specialization slots
tips.text: Slots open at skill levels 8, 12 and 20: at 16 use the top two picks, the third one comes at 20.

tips.title: Barrier Spell limits
tips.text: Barrier Spell does not stack with other invulnerability effects, and execute mechanics go through it.
